source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Data Backup and Recovery' (PDF 20): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Data backup ka matlab hai ahem data ki copy (nakal) banana. Is se data loss (data zaya hona) ya damage (kharabi) se hifazat hoti hai. Data viruses ya hardware failure (hardware kharab hone) se zaya ho sakta hai. Backup se data aasani se restore (wapas) kiya ja sakta hai. Recovery data wapas hasil karne ka process (amal) hai. Safety ke liye backup aur recovery bohat zaroori hain. Har user ko regularly (baqaidagi se) apne data ka backup lena chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Backup aur recovery mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Backup ahem data ki copy banana hai; recovery zaya hone ke baad data ko wapas hasil karna hai.

items: Backup: ahem data ki copy; recovery: data wapas lana; virus ya hardware kharabi se bachao; baqaidagi se backup lein.
